summary: BUG-2026-10-06-001 QA (Role 4) verification: non-QR policy telemetry now records both ALLOW and BLOCK events when restaurant allowNonQrOrders=false, and ZERO events when flag is on. All 11 QA checks (Q1–Q11) passed. Backend pytest smoke 4/4 + contract 14/14 (12 snapshots) PASS. Frontend checkpoints C1 (landing), C2 (add_to_cart), C3 (place_order) verified across walkin/landing/takeaway/716-carveout/menu-deep-link flows plus flag-on regression (landing, dine-in table QR, takeaway). No JS errors. No code changes made (QA role).

invariant_check: No order outcome changed. Allow paths still navigate to menu/next step and are not blocked. Block paths still show Session Expired modal and don't navigate. Place-order POST was observed as telemetry before any real order creation — review-order page stayed on review-order URL (no real order was created).
critical_code_review_comments: Nit (not blocking): postNonQrBlock relies on navigator.sendBeacon which was correctly observable by Playwright request listener as POST — no changes needed.

Observation: Q3 takeaway's Browse Menu button is correctly disabled until phone+name are filled; policy POST fires only after click handler executes, which is intended behavior and matches the C1 contract (first line of handleDiningMenuClick).
Observation: shouldBlockNonQrOrder correctly carves out 716 before applying non-qr-dinein even when allowNonQrOrders=false — produces decision=rid-716-carveout with allowed=true as spec'd.
No code changes made per QA role.

Frontend fires checkpoints at: LandingPage.handleDiningMenuClick (C1=landing), MenuItems.isBlockedNonQrAdd on first add when cart empty (C2=add_to_cart), ReviewOrder place-order flow (C3=place_order). Flag OFF simulation: context.route('**/api/config/<rid>', fetch+set allowNonQrOrders=false). Must clear localStorage+sessionStorage before each case (config is cache-first). Restaurant 478 confirmed to have orderable items (first ADD button succeeds). Takeaway landing button is disabled until phone+name are entered.
rca of the issue: Pre-fix the policy only recorded BLOCK events (allowed=false path) via postNonQrBlock, making ALLOW decisions on the same gated flows invisible for operations analytics. Fix: buildNonQrBlockPayload now adds decision+allowed fields and is called on BOTH branches whenever allowNonQrOrders===false. Backend NonQrBlockEvent now accepts optional decision (<=40 chars) and allowed:bool, with two rolling caps per restaurant (200 blocked / 1000 allowed). Invariant preserved: no order outcome altered — only observability added.
